electric-violet.$description: Electric Violet — Primary action buttons, filled CTAs, link accents, key icon strokes — the deepest saturated violet in the system carries every conversion moment with maximum voltage against the warm canvas

voltage-mid.$description: Voltage Mid — Hover and active states on the primary violet, selected nav background, secondary fills — carries the brand's chromatic weight when Electric Violet is too loud

iris-accent.$description: Iris Accent — Violet outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges.

lilac-wash.$description: Lilac Wash — Soft section backgrounds, card borders on light surfaces, tinted containers — the lightest tint of the brand violet, used to suggest brand presence without committing to full color

periwinkle-border.$description: Periwinkle Border — Repeated decorative border tint on light surfaces — sits between Lilac Wash and Iris Accent to provide mid-violet hairline structure on cards and feature frames

chartreuse-receipt.$description: Chartreuse Receipt — Promotional top banner, highlight callouts, dark-card accent fill — the lone non-violet chromatic in the system, used as a small loud receipt that draws the eye to announcements

powder-blue.$description: Powder Blue — Soft highlight washes on product UI mockups, subtle background tints — a cool counterpoint to the warm violet palette, appears only in product screenshots and small badges

bone-canvas.$description: Bone Canvas — Page background, hero canvas, the base layer every surface sits on — a near-white with a barely-warm cast that distinguishes the system from stark pure white

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Card surfaces, elevated panels, button text on dark fills, product UI chrome — the brightest layer above the Bone Canvas

obsidian-ink.$description: Obsidian Ink — Primary text, dominant borders, dark product card backgrounds, button text on light fills — a near-black with the faintest violet cast that ties dark surfaces back to the brand

carbon-border.$description: Carbon Border — Structural borders on cards and dividers, secondary text in dense lists, icon strokes on dark surfaces

graphite.$description: Graphite — Navigation borders, secondary button borders, supporting text — a dark neutral that sits between Obsidian Ink and Carbon Border

slate-helper.$description: Slate Helper — Muted helper text, inactive form labels, low-priority dividers

lavender-gray.$description: Lavender Gray — Muted secondary text, subtle card borders on lighter surfaces — carries a slight cool-violet undertone that keeps it from clashing with the brand palette

midnight-surface.$description: Midnight Surface — Dark feature card backgrounds (e.g. cap table live view), product showcase panels — a violet-tinted near-black for dark cards in a light-themed system

plus-jakarta-sans.$description: Display headlines — the only place this font appears, reserved for hero and section titles where a heavy condensed-ish sans slams the page with negative tracking; tighter than Inter at the same size gives display lines extra punch

inter.$description: Sub-headlines and sub-copy beneath Plus Jakarta Sans displays — the light weight creates a deliberate typographic contrast where the heavy display does the shouting and the thin Inter does the whispering
